artifacts.summary: Identifies the complete generated-surface set a .lean edit forces (typst/generated/status.typ unconditionally; a directory-ancestor-chain of ~36 registered README.md inventory blocks; two narrower conditional surfaces), verifies the gap against tasks 749/750's actual plans, and recommends extending plan-file-scope-harvest.sh's output with a generator-presence-gated post-processing step.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, README.md files register generated inventory tables via `<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory dir=X rows=... --> ... <!-- END GENERATED -->`, rewritten by `scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory`. `rows=subdirs`/`rows=totals` aggregate line counts RECURSIVELY over the whole dir=X subtree (scripts/lib/live_walk.py's live_files() is os.walk-based), so a .lean edit anywhere under X can make every ancestor directory's registered block stale, not just X's own README. At least one block also carries a hand-pinned row naming a file OUTSIDE its scanned directory (FormalSystem/README.md's `../FormalSystem.lean` row), which survives regeneration by row-key and refreshes its own count independent of the dir= scan. A simple ancestor-chain `dir=` membership test (collect every README registering dir=A for A ranging over a file's own directory up through every ancestor to repo root) reproduces the correct affected-README set without needing to model rows= semantics at all.

In BimodalLogic, typst/generated/status.typ (scripts/typst-status-counts.sh) is forced stale by far more than Metalogic/ sorry-count changes: it also carries FORMALSYSTEM_FILE_COUNT/LINE_COUNT, TESTS_FILE_COUNT/LINE_COUNT, and TOOLS_FILE_COUNT/LINE_COUNT fields covering the ENTIRETY of FormalSystem/, Tests/, and BimodalTools/ respectively. Any .lean edit under those three trees that changes a file's line count or the file count is a status.typ-staleness candidate, checked by scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --counts-only (the pre-commit gate). By contrast, typst/generated/automation-module-map.typ (Check 2b) is narrowly scoped to FormalSystem/Automation/{Tactics,ProofSearch}/*.lean + SuccessPatterns.lean only, and typst/generated/machine-appendix.{jsonl,typ} (Check 3) is tied to the Axiom/DerivationTree constructor blocks and needs a Lean-interpreter run, not a line-count scan -- neither of the latter two is forced by an arbitrary .lean edit.
